row.answer: Lulu is a support mage whose magic damage and shields scale with AP. She strengthens allies with shields and attack speed, while polymorph and Wild Growth disrupt enemies.

row.answer: Pix follows Lulu and fires magic-damage bolts when she basic attacks; other units can intercept them. When transferred to an allied champion, Pix fires with that champion's basic attacks instead.
